description: 한국전력거래소_지역별 시간별 태양광 발전량 정보 [electricity and power] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국전력거래소. ㅇ 신·재생에너지 발전사업자는 전력거래를 위해 발전설비용량 1,000kW 이하는 전력시장을 통하지 않고 전기판매업자(한전)와 전력거래를 하거나 전력거래소의 회원으로 가입하여 전력시장에서. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국전력거래소. Its tags are 시간별, 지역별, 태양광, 발전량, 정보. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2026-08-13 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
